'''Rick Sollman''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 55 from Edinboro, Pa. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

A Penn State political science student, he played from December 1995. He was Red 55 in the Coruscant region, from Edinboro, PA.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sollmanrick.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 55 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119113300/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sollmanrick.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
